in_arabic.name: سبيقون
in_arabic.meaning: الذين سبقوا في الخير و الفضل

in_urdu.name: سابقون
in_urdu.meaning: جو پہلے سے ہی اچھائی اور فضل میں سبقت لے گئے
in_urdu.long_meaning: سابقون نام کا مطلب ہے جو لوگ اچھائی اور فضل میں دوسروں سے 앞서 گئے، اس نام کی اصطلاحی روٹ عربی زبان کے 'س-ب-ق' سے لی گئی ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'سبقت لینا' یا 'آگے بڑھنا'، یہ نام ان شخصیات کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو دینی اور اخلاقی معاملات میں دوسروں سے آگے رہتے ہیں

in_hindi.name: साबिकून
in_hindi.meaning: जो अच्छे काम में पहले से ही आगे हैं
in_hindi.long_meaning: साबिकून नाम का अर्थ है जो लोग अच्छे कामों में पहले से ही आगे हैं और अच्छे कार्यों में स्पर्धा करते हैं, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है और इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में भी मिलता है

in_pashto.name: سابقون
in_pashto.meaning: چې مخکې يې په خير او فضل کې سي
in_pashto.long_meaning: سابقون د دې معنی لري کسان چې په خير او فضل کې يې مخکې سي، دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره استعماليږي چې په دينی او اخلاقي چارو کې يې د نورو څخه مخکې والی کړې

in_english.name: Sabiqun

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name "Sabiqun" holds a significant cultural meaning in the Islamic civilization, as it refers to those individuals who strive to live a life of piety, righteousness, and faith, and precede others in their good deeds and adherence to Islamic values. This name corresponds to an ideal that is deeply ingrained in Islamic culture: striving for excellence and working to better oneself, as well as one's community, through good works and acts of service. Individuals bearing the name "Sabiqun" may be seen as role models and inspirations within their communities, encouraging others to follow their example and consistently seek progress in their spiritual journeys.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Sabiqun" carries a deep spiritual significance within the Islamic faith, as it emphasizes the importance of preceding others in faith and good deeds. This name is a reminder of the Ahadith (sayings of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him), which encourage Muslims to strive towards excellence and readiness in their faith, thereby earning the reward both in this world and in the Hereafter. For those who bear this name, it becomes a constant reminder of their inherent responsibility to live a life of near perfection, seeking approbation from Allah Almighty alone, and constantly working towards improving their character and actions in accordance with Islamic teachings. The name "Sabiqun" thereby imparts a sense of determination and purpose, as individuals are motivated to precede their peers in their spiritual growth, conscious of the rewards and blessings that come with consistent faith and piety.
